recap.periodEnd: Fri, Nov 6, 2026, 4:00 PM ET (that day's close)
recap.timezoneNote: All times below are shown in ET (America/New_York). Items marked headline were written only from the publisher's headline and summary.

driver.text: Per WSJ, U.S. stocks ended mixed after strong jobs data and a modest rebound for AI companies failed to quell investor nerves about the sustainability of the AI boom (5:01 PM ET). Bloomberg reported that the Treasury market pared a steep weekly advance after strong October employment data revived wagers on a Federal Reserve rate hike next month (8:47 AM ET), and that selling by trend-following systematic funds amplified Thursday's record plunge in Nasdaq 100 market value (1:49 PM ET). WSJ reported Taiwan activated market-stabilization measures after the global AI-related selloff (6:16 AM ET), and that oil futures ended little changed but sharply lower on the week on hopes for a negotiated solution to the Middle East conflict (4:14 PM ET).

items.headline: Alibaba sets Nov 18 board meeting for September-quarter results; announcement Nov 19
items.summary: In a Form 6-K filed with the SEC (accepted 6:01 AM ET), Alibaba said its board will meet to discuss unaudited results for the three months and six months ended September 30, 2026, with the results announcement on November 18, 2026 and the results approved and announced on November 19, 2026, per the filing's wording. items.headline: Musk says Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at Texas Gigafactory
items.summary: Per SCMP, Tesla would wind down Cybertruck production at its Texas gigafactory around mid-2027, CEO Elon Musk said on Friday in an X post, after years of persistently weak sales; WSJ's headline likewise says the truck will wind down production amid slow sales, and MarketWatch's says the run comes to an end. Tesla closed up 4.23% on Nov 6. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

items.headline: Google takes over Wyoming data center that Crusoe had pitched
items.summary: Per Bloomberg, Google has bought out Crusoe's data center site in southeast Wyoming, opting to take on the project itself after the AI computing company failed to lock in customers. Alphabet (GOOG) closed up 0.78% on Nov 6. Written from the headline and the publisher's summary only.

morning.timezoneNote: All times shown in ET (America/New_York). Items marked headline were written only from the publisher's headline and summary.

driver.text: Per WSJ, Asian equities slumped as the rout in artificial-intelligence-linked stocks continued, sending tech-heavy indexes toward bear-market territory (3:51 AM ET), while Nasdaq futures recovered some ground ahead of U.S. jobs data due later Friday (5:06 AM ET). Bloomberg reported Taiwan authorized its National Financial Stabilization Fund to support its stock market (5:35 AM ET) and imposed short-selling curbs (5:48 AM ET), and that selling by trend-following systematic funds amplified Thursday's record plunge in Nasdaq 100 market value (5:30 AM ET). The Financial Times reported futures point to small gains at the opening bell (6:10 AM ET). WSJ reported Treasury yields turned higher ahead of the jobs data (6:23 AM ET) and oil fell below $100 a barrel as investors focused on Washington's next move on Iran (3:58 AM ET).
